nodes.label: CALIB — marking calibration prompt fragment
nodes.rationale: Encodes anti-inflation AND anti-compression marking policy: state-wide score distributions are given as context only (not a quota), best-fit banding is mandated, and a consistency check reconciles criterion ratings with the holistic score — designed to make the AI mark like a real VCAA assessor rather than a lenient or overly cautious one.

nodes.label: EXAMCTX — exam context prompt fragment
nodes.rationale: Grounds the AI's judgement in real exam constraints (3-hour handwritten exam, ~55-60 minutes per section) so it does not penalise exam-appropriate length or expect take-home polish.

nodes.label: Th.E.S.A.M.L. Body Paragraph Method
nodes.rationale: Only the Thematic topic sentence (Th) and Linking sentence (L) must appear in fixed order; Evidence, Symbols, Authorial intention, and Metalanguage can be woven through the paragraph to maximise marks under VCE assessment criteria.

nodes.label: Hinge Sentence Technique
nodes.rationale: Introducing two related ideas in a topic sentence (linked by because/but/so) and bridging them with a hinge sentence signals a shift in focus to the reader, producing a more complex and insightful paragraph than single-idea contentions.

nodes.label: Contention (Essay Writing)
nodes.rationale: A contention should be specific and sophisticated rather than general, engaging directly with authorial intent and character motivation so the marker can see a clear, defensible position on the prompt.

nodes.label: Essay Proofreading Checklist
